sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R. Case No.43 of 2024, pending on the file of learned Sessions Judge, I/C, Koraput arising out of Borigumma P.S. Case No. 21 of 2024 for commission of the alleged offence under Section 294/323/376(1) of IPC.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Sessions Judge, I/C, Koraput-Jeypore by order dated 15.04.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 25.01.2024 and as charge sheet has already been filed on 01.03.2024, he may be released on bail.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

7. Perused the deposition of the victim-P.W.1 which is on record.
8.
Considering the same, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
